title: Turning music into a chore is how I became a musician (2022)
summary: A musician recounts how treating music practice as a daily chore rather than waiting for inspiration was the key to their artistic development, emphasizing discipline and consistency over motivation.
problem_solved: How to actually improve at music and become a working artist by building consistent practice habits instead of relying on sporadic inspiration.
why_valuable: It offers practical, relatable advice for aspiring musicians that counters the romantic notion of waiting for inspiration, showing that artistic growth comes from daily work.
